jumpstart.name: Termux (F-Droid build)
jumpstart.desc: Must be the F-Droid/GitHub build — the Play Store one is abandoned.
jumpstart.cmd: # Install from https://f-droid.org/packages/com.termux/ — NOT Google Play

jumpstart.name: pkg update + upgrade
jumpstart.desc: First command in a fresh Termux

jumpstart.name: termux-setup-storage
jumpstart.desc: Grants access to shared device storage

jumpstart.name: git + curl + wget + openssh
jumpstart.cmd: pkg install -y git curl wget openssh

jumpstart.name: Node.js LTS
jumpstart.desc: Required for Claude Code, Gemini CLI

jumpstart.desc: Termux User Repository — where ollama lives

jumpstart.name: Ollama (tur-repo)
jumpstart.desc: CPU-only on Android — small models only

jumpstart.desc: Agentic coding CLI — runs in Termux

jumpstart.name: Scout → llama3.2:3b
jumpstart.desc: Smallest always-warm companion — the realistic one on-device

jumpstart.name: Daisy → gemma2:2b
jumpstart.desc: 2B model — fits comfortably in phone RAM

jumpstart.name: Spark → phi3.5:latest
jumpstart.desc: Compact — fastest option on low-RAM devices

jumpstart.name: Remote Ollama fallback
jumpstart.desc: Prefer the LAN box for anything above 3B

jumpstart.name: Termux:API
jumpstart.desc: Battery, clipboard, TTS, sensors from the shell

jumpstart.name: sshd on port 8022
jumpstart.desc: SSH into the phone from the desktop
jumpstart.cmd: pkg install -y openssh && sshd && echo "Connect: ssh -p 8022 $(whoami)@<phone-ip>"

jumpstart.desc: Mesh VPN — joins the phone to the T1NK3R cluster
